Digitone /// Elements (Volume 01) is a collection of 188 presets for the Elektron Digitone II.
It contains presets for various electronic music genres, with an emphasis on:

UK GARAGE
TECH HOUSE
DnB
VAPORTRAP
DOWNTEMPO
TECHNO
AND MORE

It contains:

20 ARPEGGIOS
37 BASSES
38 DRUMS
8 FX
46 LEADS
9 PADS
30 SYNTHS

Watch / listen to the demo patterns here: https://youtu.be/C5MvAtKSLFI
Check out a preset playthrough here: https://youtu.be/M-UCflDMWjs

A majority of these presets were created for and used in my live performance for FWA 2023.
Here them in context here: https://youtu.be/7_UxRo2sPjI
